title: Unit – 4 : Session – 12 : SLO – 1  |  Mini Project Integrating a Programming Paradigm
sections: 1. paradigm — a good project should demonstrate a real-world application of a programming paradigm (functional, logic, OOP, parallel or distributed).
2. design — final documentation should include design (problem statement, architecture), implementation, and results.

1. b) Web app using recursion and higher-order functions — this genuinely exercises the functional paradigm; the other options rely on mutable global state, side effects or randomness, which functional programming avoids.
